title: jubilant honey-glazed malaysian duck biryani
description: a festive and flavorful malaysian dish featuring tandoor-cooked duck in a malty, velvety honey glaze, served atop a fragrant basmati rice biryani.
instructions: preheat the tandoor clay oven or grill to 400°f.
season the duck breast with salt and black pepper.
brush the honey mixture onto the duck breast and cook in the tandoor clay oven or grill for 10-12 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°f.
meanwhile, cook the basmati rice according to package instructions.
in a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
add the ginger paste and lemongrass paste and cook for 1 minute.
add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
reduce the heat to low and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
fluff the cooked basmati rice with a fork and stir in the chopped scallions, toasted cashews, and salt.
to assemble the biryani, place a scoop of the basmati rice mixture in a bowl, top with a piece of the duck breast, and serve immediately.
garnish with additional chopped scallions and toasted cashews if desired.
